rows.grounds: past passive participle of kath; declared or explained
past passive participle of śru; received by hearing
action or observance undertaken; that which is sought or performed

items.question: What teachings regarding the sacred abode and auspicious practice have been fully conveyed to the listener?
premises: The meeting-place and abode have been declared.
The auspicious practice has been heard by the listener.
Both instruction and reception of these teachings are complete.
items.inference: The exposition of the sacred place and the auspicious practice has been fully communicated and received.
uncertainties: The precise sense of ceṣṭitaṃ as desired, performed, or prescribed practice is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The meeting-place and abode have been told, and the auspicious practice has been heard by you.
